verdict.rationale: Firstbase's pricing page lists "Easy financial data exports" for its bookkeeping service, which is a first-party export capability, but it covers only financial data and is a single thin mention. Nothing shows a full-account export covering compliance records, mail scans, stored documents or tax filings, and no formats are named. missing for 10: export of all data beyond financial records, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/PDF), a documented offboarding/account-exit process, independent or hands-on corroboration.
